title: Client Onboarding Sequence
summary: Complete client onboarding sequence for the AI Operations Audit product.
content:
Client Onboarding Sequence: AI Operations Audit

Date: 2026-03-12 Author: Steve (AI Advisory Lead) Status: COMPLETE Milestone: #4 - Client Onboarding Sequence

Everything between "audit booked" and "discovery session starts." Five touchpoints that make a $2,500 client feel like they hired a real operation.

1. WELCOME EMAIL (sent immediately after booking)

Subject: You're booked. Here's what happens next.

Body:

[First Name],

Thanks for booking your AI Operations Audit with AOM. You made a smart call.

Here's what to expect:

Your Discovery Session

  • Duration: 2-3 hours (conversational, not an interrogation)
  • Format: [Video call / In-person] on [DATE] at [TIME] [TIMEZONE]
  • Purpose: We map every workflow in your business to find where AI saves you the most time and money

What We Look At

  • Your current tools and software stack
  • Daily workflows and communication patterns
  • Time drains and repetitive tasks
  • Existing automations (if any)
  • Follow-up and lead response speed
  • Scheduling, invoicing, and admin processes

What You Get Within 5-7 business days after the session, you'll receive your custom AI Operations Roadmap. This is a prioritized, actionable plan showing exactly which automations to implement, in what order, and the projected ROI for each one. No generic advice. Built on your actual data.

Your AOM Contacts

  • Patrik Matheson, Lead Advisor: hello@aom-inhouse.com
  • Scheduling changes: [scheduling link]
  • Questions before your session: Reply to this email

We'll send a short prep checklist 48 hours before your session. Nothing heavy. Just a few things to have handy so we can make the most of our time together.

Looking forward to working with you.

Patrik Matheson AOM | Ahead of Market aheadofmarket.com

2. PRE-SESSION PREP CHECKLIST (sent 48 hours before session)

Subject: Quick prep for your AI audit on [DAY]

Body:

[First Name],

Your AI Operations Audit is [DAY] at [TIME]. Here's a short checklist to help us hit the ground running.

Who Should Be There

  • You (the decision maker)
  • One operations person who knows the day-to-day workflows (office manager, ops lead, or whoever touches the most systems)
  • That's it. Two people max keeps things focused.

What to Have Handy You don't need to prepare a presentation. Just have these accessible:

  • List of software/tools your team uses (CRM, accounting, scheduling, email marketing, project management, etc.)
  • A rough org chart or team structure (even a quick sketch works)
  • Your top 3 pain points right now (where does time disappear?)
  • Any automations you've already tried (even simple ones like email auto-responders or Zapier workflows)
  • A ballpark of your monthly software spend

What You Don't Need

  • No login credentials needed during the audit. If we move to the build phase, we'll request access then with proper security protocols.
  • No reports or financials. We're focused on workflows, not your books.

How the Session Works This is a conversation, not a questionnaire. We'll walk through a typical day/week at your business, ask questions about how things actually work (not how they're supposed to work), and identify the gaps where AI can make an immediate impact.

Most clients say it feels like a productive strategy session, not an audit.

See you [DAY].

Patrik Matheson AOM | Ahead of Market

3. 24-HOUR REMINDER (sent day before session)

Subject: Tomorrow at [TIME] - your AI audit

Body:

[First Name],

Quick reminder: your AI Operations Audit is tomorrow at [TIME] [TIMEZONE].

[Video call link / Address]

If you had a chance to pull together that tool list and think about your top pain points, great. If not, don't stress. We'll figure it out together.

Looking forward to it.

Patrik

4. NDA / SERVICE AGREEMENT TEMPLATE

Document Title: AI Operations Audit - Service Agreement & Confidentiality Terms

Section 1: Parties

  • Provider: AOM (Ahead of Market), Phoenix, AZ
  • Client: [Company Name], [Address]
  • Effective Date: [Date]

Section 2: Scope of Engagement

The Provider will conduct a comprehensive AI Operations Audit ("the Audit") of the Client's business workflows, tools, and processes. The Audit includes:

  • One discovery session (2-3 hours)
  • Analysis of current tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
  • Delivery of a custom AI Operations Roadmap within 5-7 business days of the discovery session
  • One review meeting to walk through findings and recommendations

The Audit does NOT include implementation, tool purchases, or ongoing services. Those are scoped separately if the Client chooses to proceed.

Section 3: Investment

  • Audit fee: $2,500 (one-time)
  • Payment terms: Due upon booking. Non-refundable if cancelled within 48 hours of the scheduled session.
  • Rescheduling: Permitted with 48 hours notice at no additional charge.

Section 4: Confidentiality

Both parties agree to keep all shared information confidential. Specifically:

Provider commits to:

  • Not disclosing Client's business data, workflows, financials, or proprietary processes to any third party
  • Using Client information solely for the purpose of delivering the Audit and Roadmap
  • Ensuring all team members involved in the engagement are bound by confidentiality obligations
  • Destroying or returning all Client data upon request after engagement concludes

Client commits to:

  • Not sharing the Roadmap methodology, frameworks, or proprietary analysis tools with third parties
  • Not reproducing or redistributing the delivered Roadmap outside their organization

Section 5: Data Handling & Security

  • All Client data is stored on encrypted, access-controlled systems
  • No Client data is used to train AI models or shared with AI service providers without explicit written consent
  • Access to Client data is limited to AOM team members directly involved in the engagement
  • Provider maintains [cyber insurance policy details - PENDING Patrik action item]
  • Provider is committed to SOC 2 compliance standards for all data handling

Note: Cyber insurance policy must be secured before this agreement is used with clients. This is a Patrik action item. Do not send this agreement without active cyber insurance coverage.

Section 6: Deliverables & Intellectual Property

  • The AI Operations Roadmap is the Client's property upon delivery and payment
  • AOM retains the right to use anonymized, aggregate data from engagements for internal benchmarking
  • AOM may reference the Client as a customer (company name only) unless the Client opts out in writing

Section 7: Limitation of Liability

  • The Audit provides recommendations, not guarantees of outcomes
  • ROI projections in the Roadmap are estimates based on industry benchmarks and Client-provided data
  • Provider's total liability is limited to the Audit fee paid

Section 8: Term & Termination

  • This agreement covers the Audit engagement only
  • Either party may terminate with written notice
  • If terminated before Roadmap delivery, a prorated refund will be provided based on work completed

Signatures

Provider: _________________________ Date: _________ [Patrik Matheson, AOM]

Client: _________________________ Date: _________ [Name, Title, Company]

5. POST-SESSION FOLLOW-UP (sent same day, within 2 hours of session ending)

Subject: Great session today. Here's the timeline.

Body:

[First Name],

Thanks for a great session today. [1 sentence referencing something specific discussed, e.g., "Your point about the estimating bottleneck was exactly the kind of thing this process is designed to solve."]

Here's what happens next:

Your AI Operations Roadmap

  • Delivered within 5-7 business days
  • Prioritized list of automations ranked by impact and ease of implementation
  • Projected ROI for each recommendation
  • Implementation timeline with clear phases

Review Meeting Once the Roadmap is ready, we'll schedule a 45-60 minute review meeting to walk through every recommendation, answer questions, and discuss next steps. I'll send you a link to book that as soon as the Roadmap is ready.

Quick Wins [If any quick wins were identified during the session, list them here. Examples:]

  • [e.g., "Your lead follow-up process can be automated this week with your existing CRM. I'll include the exact setup steps in the Roadmap."]
  • [e.g., "The scheduling workflow we discussed has a 15-minute fix that could save your office manager 3 hours a week. Details in the Roadmap."]

[If no quick wins: remove this section entirely. Don't force it.]

If anything comes to mind between now and when you get the Roadmap, don't hesitate to reply here or call me directly.

Patrik Matheson AOM | Ahead of Market hello@aom-inhouse.com

TIMING SUMMARY

Touchpoint When Method
Welcome email Immediately after booking Email (automated or manual)
Prep checklist 48 hours before session Email
24-hour reminder Day before session Email
NDA/Service agreement Sent with welcome email (or before, depending on booking flow) Email attachment / DocuSign
Post-session follow-up Same day, within 2 hours Email (manual, personalized)

AUTOMATION NOTES

For the first 5-10 clients, these should be sent manually by Patrik (or queued by the EA system). Personalization matters more than speed at this stage. Once the flow is proven:

  • Welcome email + NDA can be automated via booking confirmation (Calendly or custom)
  • Prep checklist can be a timed email (48hr before event trigger)
  • 24-hour reminder can be automated
  • Post-session follow-up MUST stay manual. The personal touch after a $2,500 session is non-negotiable.

WHAT'S STILL NEEDED

  • Cyber insurance secured (blocks NDA from being used) [Patrik]
  • Calendly or booking page link finalized
  • DocuSign or e-signature tool selected for NDA
  • Email sending infrastructure (hello@aom-inhouse.com or dedicated)
  • Bobby builds these as templates on the site or in the dashboard (future milestone)
